messages.author: AndyTheHusky
messages.text:
I'd like to modify Chel's suggestion of 10K people per new province. 

* **Instead of a fixed 10k per province, a new province by default will have 0 people. ** 1m or 10k people cannot come from thin air. ||I would have suggested the addition of a random X<1500 aborigines/natives but that will make this too complex.||

* During province creation, we can decide how much population will be transferred from old provinces to the new one. The more the better, naturally.

* Combined with recent growth rework, this will curb province spammers as well as put additional emphasis into planning, effectively discouraging province-vomiters (the equivalent of PS builds in DnS)
